step1.title: Select the project type that best matches your needs
step1.footerNote: Not sure of your choice? Select the type that comes closest. We will refine it together during our conversation.

siteVitrine.title: What is a showcase website?
siteVitrine.explanation: A showcase website is an informative site that presents your company, services and products without online sales. It is like a professional digital brochure available 24/7.

ecommerce.title: What is an e-commerce site?
ecommerce.explanation: An e-commerce site is an online shop that lets you sell your products/services directly online with secure payment, stock management and order tracking.

appWeb.title: What is a web application?
appWeb.explanation: A web application is business software accessible through a browser (SaaS, CRM, ERP, platform). It automates complex processes with user management, workflows and data.

auditCyber.title: What is a cybersecurity audit?
auditCyber.explanation: A cybersecurity audit is a professional analysis of the security of your IT infrastructure, applications and websites to identify vulnerabilities before they are exploited by attackers.

aiAutomation.title: What is AI automation?
aiAutomation.explanation: AI automation uses artificial intelligence (chatbots, document processing, data analysis) to automate repetitive tasks and save time in your business processes.
